cases.case_text: A short description of the presentation, in your own words or close to how you'd narrate it.
cases.initial_impression: Your first-pass read of the case before working through it in detail.
questions_to_ask: The first thing you'd ask the patient
cases.factors_toward_referral: What would push you toward referring this case.
cases.factors_against_referral: What would push you toward managing it yourself.
cases.flip_up: What would make you escalate this to something more urgent.
cases.flip_down: What would make you de-escalate this to something less urgent.
cases.red_flags: Any danger signs specific to this case.
cases.confidence: How confident you are in this disposition, in your own words.
cases.general_rule: The general rule or heuristic this case illustrates, if any.
